scoring_justification: Derived quantities (t50, density, radius, orientation mode, moment values) are recomputed from the agent's raw CSV/JSON artifacts and compared to gold thresholds/tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for recrystallization kinetics, orientation mode, and boundary moments
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Estimated from Figures 3–6 of the paper; t50 ~0.82, rho_rx_at_0.2 ~0.0015, mean_R_at_0.2 ~1.15, orientation mode ~6°, boundary moment values ~7.7° at t=0.05, etc. These are consistent with the complete mean-field model (M-F.4).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read off the published curves (axis values) for the complete mean-field model (time-updated second-order Taylor). Values are rounded to two significant digits.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results for the same model and conditions the agent must reproduce; they are the natural hidden gold for a reproduction task.

outputs.description: Initial subgrain microstructure: cell radii and reference disorientation vectors.

units.rho_rx: normalised by initial subgrain density ρ₀

outputs.description: Recrystallization kinetics: fraction, grain density, and mean recrystallized radius versus time.
Area‑weighted histograms of reference disorientation angles ω at ~50% recrystallized fraction.
Time evolution of the first two moments of the boundary disorientation angle distribution (whole microstructure).

output_contract.notes: The agent must use the model parameters as given in the paper: γ_c, μ_c, θ_c=15°, B=5, η=4, and the no‑spatial‑correlation limit α→∞. The threshold recrystallized grain radius is 8 times the mean initial radius. The simulation must include at least 5000 subgrains. All outputs are scored against hidden references derived from the paper's figures.

steps.description: Validate that the generated microstructure has mean radius ≈1 and isotropic orientation spread σ≈3.5° within tolerances.
Recompute t50 (time to 50% recrystallized fraction), rho_rx at t=0.2, and mean_R_rx at t=0.2 from the time series; compare against gold with directional thresholds.
Extract the mode (peak) of the recrystallized area fraction histogram and compare to gold mode within ±2°.
Compare mean_theta and sqrt_second_moment at t=0.05 and t=0.15 against gold values with tolerance ±1°.
